categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Orient Gene Biotech Co., Ltd primarily operates in the in vitro diagnostics (IVD) industry, focusing on immunodiagnostics (colloidal gold, fluorescence, liquid chip), molecular diagnostics (nucleic acid PCR, fluorescence in situ hybridization, liquid chip), and biochemical diagnostics. The company also has a full industry chain layout including biological raw materials, diagnostic reagents, diagnostic equipment, and medical consumables, complemented by third-party independent testing laboratories. Additionally, it has expanded into animal/pet vaccines and diagnostics, forming a dual track of human medical and animal health businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include proprietary platforms in POCT rapid diagnostics, molecular diagnostics, liquid biochip, and biochemical diagnostics. Key technologies involve high concentration nano-gold preparation, fluorescence immunoassays, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays, PCR amplification, FISH probe technology, and cell factory production processes for animal vaccines. It emphasizes autonomous development of biological raw materials such as antigens, antibodies, primers, and probes, and integrates advanced manufacturing techniques including freeze-drying and microfluidics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Orient Gene serves primarily medical institutions, laboratories, and healthcare providers globally, with a focus on infectious diseases, drug testing, tumor markers, cardiovascular markers, prenatal screening, blood glucose, autoimmune diseases, inflammation, genetic diseases, and allergens. The company’s products are used in both professional laboratory settings and point-of-care testing (POCT) scenarios. It also targets the animal health market with vaccines and diagnostics for livestock and pets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with sales in over 120 countries and regions, focusing on major markets including the Americas (notably the US and Canada), Europe (including the UK), and Asia (China, Japan, New Zealand, Australia). It has established overseas production, R&D, and logistics bases in the US, Canada, and the UK to support localized production and distribution, mitigating geopolitical and trade risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: Orient Gene operates primarily in the midstream and upstream segments of the IVD supply chain, encompassing the development and manufacturing of biological raw materials, diagnostic reagents, and diagnostic instruments. It also extends downstream by providing third-party independent testing laboratory services. The company’s vertical integration includes raw material production, reagent and equipment manufacturing, and diagnostic service provision.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on global expansion, enhancing its multi-platform technology capabilities, and deepening its product portfolio in immunodiagnostics and molecular diagnostics. R&D priorities include advancing POCT rapid diagnostics, molecular diagnostics including gene sequencing, liquid biochip technology, and animal health products. It emphasizes accelerating product registration and certification globally, optimizing cost structures, and integrating resources across subsidiaries to improve operational efficiency and market responsiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of diagnostic reagents, diagnostic instruments, and related medical consumables. The company mainly uses a distribution model with a focus on exports to Europe and the Americas, supplemented by domestic sales in China. It also engages in ODM sales and provides third-party laboratory testing services. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and acceptance of products or upon customs clearance for exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Orient Gene is positioned as a leading Chinese IVD company with a comprehensive multi-technology platform and full industry chain layout, competing with global giants like Abbott, Roche, Danaher, Siemens Healthineers, and Thermo Fisher Scientific, which collectively dominate over 50% of the global market. The company is among the top in the A-share IVD sector in China, especially noted for its export scale and product breadth. It leverages cost advantages, strong R&D, and global market penetration to compete against international incumbents and domestic peers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company experienced a significant revenue decline of over 90% to approximately RMB 820 million, primarily due to the sharp reduction in COVID-19 related testing products. Net profit attributable to shareholders turned negative, with a loss of approximately RMB 398 million. Despite this, the company maintains substantial total assets near RMB 9 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D (over 31% of revenue). The company plans for moderate growth in 2024 focusing on conventional diagnostic products and global market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Orient Gene emphasizes its unique value proposition of offering a comprehensive, vertically integrated IVD product portfolio spanning biological raw materials, reagents, instruments, and testing services. Its multi-technology platform approach, including POCT rapid diagnostics, molecular diagnostics, and liquid biochip technology, provides high sensitivity, specificity, and convenience. The company’s global localized production and sales network, combined with strong R&D capabilities and extensive patent portfolio, enable competitive pricing, rapid innovation, and broad market access, differentiating it from competitors.
